[EN] Oh! Are you here to rescue me? Well, you'll have to get through the Solonesome Cage first.

Past those guards, see the big iron cage? You have to defeat the golem inside to leave—but only one person can go into the cage. Everyone else should climb into the siege weapons and take out as many of the remaining monsters as possible. Defeat enough, and you'll receive special boosts.
[ES] ¡Oh! ¿Estás aquí para rescatarme? Bueno, primero tendrás que abrirte paso a través de la Solonesome Cage.

Pasando a esos guardias, ¿ves la gran jaula de hierro? Tienes que derrotar al gólem que está dentro para salir, pero solo una persona puede entrar a la jaula. Todos los demás deben subirse a las siege weapons y eliminar a tantos de los monstruos restantes como sea posible. Defeat enough, and you'll receive special boosts.
